description: ChecksOps SQL53 authorization-pin transfer only. Fixed script; never executes SQL.

PinPart1.description: First Base64 chunk of the exact reviewed SQL53 pin.

PinPart2.description: Second Base64 chunk of the exact reviewed SQL53 pin.

runCommand:
python3 - <<'PY'
import base64
import hashlib
import json
import os
import pathlib
import stat
import tempfile

EXPECTED_PIN_SHA256 = "1116f31148ad7a6a537c087fc85db693366a0b736926ebf30ccf4a65bf3b8471"
EXPECTED_SOURCE_SHA256 = "5a8f8bc35c69f2b339c78f3637d6bb1c606117967e3ab9d83b5dec1d37561197"
EXPECTED_FUNCTION = "public.save_claim_settlement_breakdown(uuid,uuid,jsonb)"
REPO = pathlib.Path("/opt/checksops-sql53/source")
SOURCE = REPO / "aws/workflows/sql/53_claim_settlement_breakdown.sql"
TARGET = REPO / "ops/deployment-guard/sql53-production-apply.json"

encoded = os.environ["SSM_PinPart1"] + os.environ["SSM_PinPart2"]
pin = base64.b64decode(encoded, validate=True)
if hashlib.sha256(pin).hexdigest() != EXPECTED_PIN_SHA256:
    raise SystemExit("SQL53 pin hash mismatch")
payload = json.loads(pin)
expected = {
    "authorization": "execute-authorized",
    "apply_authorized": True,
    "execute": True,
    "target_environment": "production",
    "target_component": "production-sql",
    "deployment_type": "sql53-production-apply",
    "filename": "aws/workflows/sql/53_claim_settlement_breakdown.sql",
    "migration_id": "53_claim_settlement_breakdown",
    "source_sha256": EXPECTED_SOURCE_SHA256,
    "function_identity": EXPECTED_FUNCTION,
}
if any(payload.get(key) != value for key, value in expected.items()):
    raise SystemExit("SQL53 authorization pin fields mismatch")
if hashlib.sha256(SOURCE.read_bytes()).hexdigest() != EXPECTED_SOURCE_SHA256:
    raise SystemExit("Runner SQL53 source hash mismatch")
if TARGET.is_symlink() or not TARGET.is_file():
    raise SystemExit("Runner pin target must be an existing regular file")
old_pin = TARGET.read_bytes()
old_mode = stat.S_IMODE(TARGET.stat().st_mode)

fd, backup_path = tempfile.mkstemp(prefix="sql53-pin-before-manual-transfer-", suffix=".json", dir="/tmp")
with os.fdopen(fd, "wb") as backup:
    backup.write(old_pin)
    backup.flush()
    os.fsync(backup.fileno())

fd, replacement_path = tempfile.mkstemp(prefix=".sql53-pin-approved-transfer-", dir=str(TARGET.parent))
try:
    with os.fdopen(fd, "wb") as replacement:
        replacement.write(pin)
        replacement.flush()
        os.fsync(replacement.fileno())
        os.fchmod(replacement.fileno(), old_mode)
    if TARGET.read_bytes() != old_pin:
        raise SystemExit("Runner pin changed during transfer; refusing replacement")
    os.replace(replacement_path, TARGET)
finally:
    if os.path.exists(replacement_path):
        os.unlink(replacement_path)
if TARGET.read_bytes() != pin or hashlib.sha256(TARGET.read_bytes()).hexdigest() != EXPECTED_PIN_SHA256:
    raise SystemExit("Runner pin replacement verification failed")
print("SQL53_PIN_TRANSFER_VERIFIED_NO_SQL_EXECUTED")
print("Previous pin backup: " + backup_path)
PY
